messages:
pagerduty-bot: P1 alert -> auth0 /token/verify endpoint returning 5xx and 502s, spike started ~2026-09-14T15:23:00Z. Affected: user logins failing (401) and console sessions dropping to 403. Paging maria (oncall)

maria (oncall): got it, looking. Anyone else seeing errors in token-verify service?

raj (oncall-next): I'm pulling traces and LB logs now. Saw a big jump in 502 from upstream auth0 tokeninfo on the proxy.

maria (oncall): quick sample from gateway logs (truncated):

```
POST /auth/verify 502 0.342s - upstream auth0.tokeninfo -> 502 Bad Gateway {"error":"upstream_error","code":502}
{"msg":"jwt verification failed: remote jwks fetch timed out"}
```

alex (infra): looks like remote JWKS or tokeninfo is timing out, causing our verification path to error instead of falling back. We can either: a) enable local JWKS snapshot validation, or b) route auth checks to a cached-verifier service. Which is faster?

maria (oncall): prioritize quick mitigation to reduce customer impact. sophie, any customer reports?

sophie (support): on support queue: ~9 orgs reporting login failures, 3 of them enterprise. ticket numbers: #4532 #4535 #4541. Customers are seeing immediate login failures in app and 403s when opening console.

maria (oncall): ok. I'll open an incident ticket and start mitigation.

incident-bot: Created incident INC-2026-234: auth0 token/verify outage -> P1. Runbook: auth-token-verify-outage. Oncall: maria.

raj (oncall-next): I'll take handoff in ~8 minutes. Planning mitigation: enable AUTH_JWKS_LOCAL=true and switch verifier to local snapshot (sha: abc123def) via k8s rollout at 20% -> 100%. That avoids calling tokeninfo while we work with Auth0.

alex (infra): command to flip on staging first:

```
kubectl set env deploy/auth-proxy AUTH_JWKS_LOCAL=true --namespace=prod-canary
kubectl rollout status deploy/auth-proxy -n prod-canary
```

maria (oncall): doing canary now for 20% traffic to prod-canary. watch dashboards: token-verify errors, login rate, 5xxs, auth-proxy latency.

ops-oncall: NOTE: enabling local JWKS uses cached keys — if Auth0 rotates keys while cached, we risk false positives. We'll add a TTL of 5m and a background refresh.

(2m later)

raj (oncall-next): canary looks good. Errors on that slice dropped from 320/m -> 4/m. Starting 50% rollout.

maria (oncall): rolling to 100% now.

(3m later)

alex (infra): rollout complete. Global token-verify errors now down to ~6/m (from 320/m). Console 403s reduced.

sophie (support): customers reporting recovery. I'll reply to the enterprise tenants with status update and ETA for full resolution.

maria (oncall): contacting Auth0 support/trust to confirm their tokeninfo endpoint health and to get ETA on fix. Opening support case from infra: https://manage.auth0.com/tickets/REDWOOD-789

incident-bot: Added runbook note: forced local-jwks fallback enabled at 2026-09-14T15:32Z.

maria (oncall): handoff to raj in 5. I'll stay available for context but switching to support comms. Raj, take ownership of post-mitigation checks and RCA next steps. @raj

raj (oncall-next): taking over. Action items: 1) monitor for stale key rotation issues 2) coordinate with Auth0 on root cause 3) prepare a short-term policy to auto-fallback on third-party auth failures for 24h window.

alex (infra): adding temporary prometheus alert suppression for noise on tokeninfo errors while we have fallback active.

(10m later)

ops-oncall: observed small number of sessions with signature validation errors from expired snapshot (5 users). We disabled strict deny for those flows and forced a revalidate path after Auth0 recovers.

maria (oncall): thanks team. Status: mitigated (fallback enabled), customer-facing recovery messages sent. Will schedule postmortem doc with timeline and decisions.

raj (oncall-next): leaving this thread as incident owner. I'll collect logs and add to the INC-2026-234 ticket. Next update: RCA within 48h.

sophie (support): I'll follow up with impacted customers with a short blurb and link to status page.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-234 is in mitigation state.

maria (oncall): closing paging; moving to post-incident review. If anyone observes regression re-open channel or page oncall. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: final metric snapshot before closing: token-verify 5xxs -> 6/m, login success rate back to baseline 99.7%

raj (oncall-next): acknowledged. I'll attach rollout timeline and k8s manifest snippets to the ticket.

maria (oncall): thanks all.
